name: SEBI Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF)

controls.name: Governance & Cybersecurity Resilience Policy
controls.gap_description: Formal risk appetite, Board reporting, and annual cyber resilience reviews.

controls.name: Critical Asset Identification & Dependency Mapping
controls.gap_description: Trading platform and treasury assets mapped with upstream dependencies.

controls.name: Multi-Factor Authentication & Identity Lifecycle
controls.gap_description: Hardware-backed MFA required for all systems handling investor and trading data.

controls.name: Application Security & API Protection
controls.gap_description: API rate limiting, WAF filtering, and continuous mobile banking static testing active.

controls.name: 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) & Telemetry
controls.gap_description: SIEM logs ingested; 24/7 proactive threat hunting and rapid containment needed.

controls.name: Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity Testing
controls.gap_description: Secondary DR site requires immutable sync to achieve SEBI 2-hour RTO mandate.
